title: Node2Shell: Google Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, remote code execution via crafted Brotli streams

library.remedy: upgrade the system brotli package (libbrotli1 / brotli-libs / brotli) and rebuild container images from updated bases

remedy: upgrade Node.js to 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1 (rebuild images; 18 and 20 get no fix) or Bun to 1.4.4, and upgrade the system brotli package; if the app does not need compressed request bodies set body-parser inflate: false

CVE-2026-111497.summary: streaming Brotli decoder treats an invalid block switch as 'need more input' and keeps appending to an 8-byte buffer; reachable through Content-Encoding: br request bodies (Express 5 / body-parser 2 inflate by default), fetch() responses and zlib.brotliDecompress on untrusted data; CISA KEV 2026-10-27; vendored copies in Node.js, Bun, .NET and Python wheels need their own update, the system libbrotli1 covers curl and distro-built nodejs
